full_judgment: 5. Trial Court decreed the suit by judgment and decree dated 07.11.2024. As against the same defendant preferred Family Appeal Number 10 of 2025 in the court of District Judge which was subsequently transferred to the Court of Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Khulna. In appeal defendant-appellant filed two applications on 27.07.2025 for production of additional evidence which are appended to the revisional application as annexures- B and B-1. Those applications were rejected by the appellate court by the impugned order number 9 dated 04.08.2025. As against the same defendant-appellant as petitioner preferred the instant revision and obtained rule on 28.08.2025.
